0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The sprightly Loporrit has lost track of their friends, and could use a helping hand.

24.original: Search for and aid wayward Loporrits.

48.original: You're that visitor everyone's been talking about. I don't suppose you have time to assist me in a matter of life and death?

49.original: Four of my friends went out to patrol the moon and mine for ore. They should be back by now, but... Well, I'm worried something happened!

50.original: I can't say I'm too keen on the idea of coming face-to-facelike-growth with one of those roving fungi by myself, though. Could you come along? Please come along...

51.original: Thank you! Let's hop to it, then. My friends were headed toward the Chlorophosgrot.

52.original: Sweet Mother Hydaelyn! I hope they're all right...

54.original: I-I'm not slacking! I, erm...passed out after a weeper ambushed me. Yes, that's definitely what happened.

55.original: If you're looking for the others, they went ahead to survey the Chlorophosgrot and the area around the Cradle of Darkness. I'd get them myself, but I'm much too laz─er, that is, exhausted from my encounter with the weeper.

56.original: The others are either there in the Chlorophosgrot or near the Cradle of Darkness... I'm sure they're fine, though. They're nowhere near as, uh...exhausted...as I am.

58.original: This hole sure is deep. Drop a rock in there, and you'll never hear it hit the bottom...

59.original: Oh, it's you! Is something the matter?

60.original: Eep! Sorry for the bother─I didn't realize I'd been gone so long. I'll head back right away.

61.original: Mining makes me so...so sleepy. Must...stay...awake...

62.original: ...Hmmm? Oh, is it time to go back already? I hardly got anything done. Oh well!

63.original: I'm sure this plant wasn't here last time... Well, would you look at that, it's made my paw all tingly. Numb, even... Surely there's some use for this!

64.original: Goodness me! Time to head back, is it? I was so focused, I completely lost track of time.

65.original: How far down could that hole go, I wonder?

66.original: <yawn> Maybe I'll get some proper mining done next time.

67.original: I can't feel my arm now. But it still moves, so it's fine, right? ...Right?

68.original: I feel much better after that brief and totally regulation-compliant break. Let's head back and sift through the spoils of our expedition!

69.original: I hope they don't think you're impressed by their shenanigans... <sigh> Honestly!

70.original: Thanks again for helping me round everyone up. I'm glad no one was hurt...

71.original: They were lucky this time, but with those fungi and other odd creatures out there, I think we'll have to reconsider our patrol routes from now on. For a mercy, there are plenty of places to mine for ore nearby.

72.original: Before you go, I'd like you to have this. Don't be a stranger!
